body.ai_agent_hint: Use this endpoint to find available time slots for booking reservations. ROOM SELECTION: omit room_id or send 0 unless the customer asked for a specific room or named a device in it; a positive room filters out every globally occupied time for that room. branch_id remains optional for this discovery request. When you send it, the room must belong to that active branch; when you omit it, no branch is selected or inferred from the room. HOW LONG THE SESSION IS IS NOT YOURS TO DECIDE: pass service_ids (one service) and, for a retouch, appointment_type=retouch plus retouch_reservation_id, and the server reads the length from the clinic's service configuration and OVERRIDES any duration you sent. Read it back from duration_minutes and always book time_to = chosen start + duration_minutes; duration_source tells you where it came from. WHICH MINUTES ARE REAL: pass include_starts=true and book ONLY a time listed in merged_starts (or, when the customer named a therapist, in that therapist's available_starts). A minute that merely falls inside a range was never validated — the ranges union several therapists and each one's grid sits on their own shift. Every returned time starts strictly after the clinic's local "now" — a day the clinic has already finished comes back with no therapists at all, and on the current day the elapsed part of each window is trimmed away, so anything you see here can still be booked. DEFAULT PATH — THE CUSTOMER HAS NOT ASKED FOR ANYONE BY NAME: quote times ONLY, from merged_slots, which is the union of every available therapist for that date already merged into continuous ranges. Do NOT mention any therapist name, and do NOT say how many are free — the customer chooses a time, not a person. Then call POST /reservations with therapist_id=0 and the chosen time_from/time_to: the system assigns whoever is free, and stamps the booking isTherapistAny=Y so the clinic can see no preference was expressed. ONLY IF THE CUSTOMER ASKS FOR A NAMED THERAPIST, or asks who is available: then you may use the per-therapist slots array, give the name(s), and book with that explicit therapist_id — the booking is then stamped isTherapistAny=N. Never volunteer a name the customer did not ask for. Note: the selected time range must fit within one of the ranges you quoted. Therapists on leave are listed in therapists_on_leave with absence_type (all_day or partial_day) and optional time range for partial leaves. Check schedule_notes for any exceptions or closures. therapists_summary carries per-therapist data (is_therapist, is_doctor, utilization_percentage, services); utilization_percentage is worked minutes over the last 17 days vs one week of scheduled hours and is INTERNAL — never quote it or rank staff out loud to a customer.
